label: Sfx: Aureole's cast, entry and close arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: The three new voices of v82 s4, in the synth only (the fourth, the blessing, is the existing spark collect). The arms go BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback (mode `before`, its anchor the fallback line itself), so the 11 other relics that still fall through keep it and another relic's row anchored there applies in either order. Through the patched play() every arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 7e-08, on two noise draws), 137 other voices are unchanged (worst 1e-07), and ult/aureole is no longer rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the three voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 9e-08).

label: tickHalo: the entry note, on an inside tick after an outside tick of the same window
anchor: if (!(Math.hypot(foe.x - f.x, foe.y - f.y) < u.haloR + R)) continue;
why: Before tickHalo's inside test (kept unchanged): the same test repeated into a const, one SFX.play when it is true after a false one in the same window, and the answer kept on the halo's record as `voiceIn` -- a field nothing in the simulation reads, born undefined with each cast. 3091/3091 entries voiced (151 windows opened with the foe already inside: no entry); 148/148 fights identical and every other SFX call identical in order and opts; the rows plus one sim write come back 3/148; end to end, the rows applied as text: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's.

label: tickHalo: the heal chime (spark collect, unchanged), once per blessing, with the count
why: After the blessing's own tally line (kept unchanged): the existing spark collect with n = the blessing she now carries, Zenith's call word for word. 2878/2878 blessings voiced, each with the count its apply left; nothing is read back; end to end, the rows applied as text: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's.

label: tickHalo: the close, on a clock close with both alive, before the close line
code:
/* BENEDICTION'S CLOSE (v82 s4: "close -- the swell reversed"): on
         the frame the halo runs out BY ITS CLOCK with both fighters alive. A
         caster's death ends the fight, and a close after the foe's death
         belongs to its kill flight, so both are left to the death voice
         (Tendril's, Canopy's, Zenith's and Lightkeeper's rule); a halo still
         up when the fight ends closes in the picture only. Presentation
         only; the next line is the sim's own close, unchanged. */
      if (Z.t >= Z.dur && f.alive && foe.alive) SFX.play("ult", { w: "aureole-close" });
why: One guarded SFX.play before the window's own close line (kept unchanged), reading only Z.t, Z.dur and the two alive flags: a clock close with both alive. 409 closes for 409 clock closes, none on the 49 closes a death made or the 48 halos the fight's end cut off; nothing is read back; end to end, the rows applied as text: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's.
